name: view_duel_cork_survives_a_multitick_horn
description: My cork keeps its salt when the CORK and the horn run in one frame of several ticks (Game._drop_stale, contract-m7.md §3), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker, who says Ready on its window's first tick. main.gd calls Game.before_tick() before every tick but hands the simulation's events to Game once a frame, so the CORK's own EV_CORK comes after the horn has moved the tray's window on: the waiting cork must not be dropped as stale while its bottle stands, but take its salt by commitment first. In window 3 at 6 ticks a frame and in window 4 at 20, my cork and my Ready go out together: the bottle stands with its salt here (not 'lost'), nothing of the cork still waits, and at 24 s the client uncorks it itself, so it never fizzles.

steps.assert: first[0] > 0 and first[1] > 0 and Game.bottles_of(1).size() == 1 and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').in_wave(3)
steps.msg: at 6 ticks a frame: my cork stood and the horn sounded in the same frame

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] != '' and Game._corks_waiting.is_empty()
steps.msg: the bottle holds its salt here: the waiting cork took it by commitment, not dropped as stale
the client uncorked it itself at 24 s: it never fizzled

steps.assert: second[0] > 0 and second[1] > 0 and Game.bottles_of(1).size() == 2 and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').in_wave(4)
steps.msg: at 20 ticks a frame: my second cork stood and the horn sounded in the same frame

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['window'] == 4 and Game._corks_waiting.is_empty()
steps.msg: the second bottle holds its salt too
and the client uncorked it at 24 s
